name: Richard Ojeda
desc: American politician and retired U.S. Army officer
summary:
Richard Neece Ojeda II ( oh-JED-ə; born October 25, 1970) is an American politician and retired United States Army major who is the member-elect for North Carolina's 9th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served in the West Virginia Senate, representing the 7th district from December 2016 until January 2019.
Raised in Logan, West Virginia, Ojeda graduated from West Virginia State University and Webster University.
